scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait db
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,gateway,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "node --env-file=.env scripts/dev-frontend.mjs"
